This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 05/22/2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Northwind
Trading Inc, with its registered office at 1200 Industrial Parkway, Springfield ("Party A"), and Crestview Supplies LLC, with its registered
office at 1200 Industrial Parkway, Springfield ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 24 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in accordance with
Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the purposes of this
Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York.
